name: Lingering Breath (Mythic)
body:
Your breath weapon’s effects are more severe.

Prerequisite(s): Lingering Breath, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): Your lingering breath deals an additional number of lingering damage points equal to your mythic tier.

Legendary Prestige, © 2023, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
